video.label: From one recruit to one thunder
video.description: A 41-second film with burned-in captions: install Blowhorn on as many machines as you like, they fall in as one unit, from a fireteam up, one order goes to one machine, your team joins as a squad, and Major Blowhorn's one call lands on LinkedIn, X, Bluesky, Reddit, GitHub, Hacker News and Slack.

variants.headline: Automate your social voice. Plug in AI anytime.
variants.subhead: Blowhorn posts exactly what you approve to LinkedIn, X, Reddit, Hacker News and more, from your own Chrome. Bring any AI agent, model or assistant.
variants.note: AI hybrid messaging (Yi, 2026-10-20). What Blowhorn is in four words, then the hybrid: scripted posting, AI whenever you want it.

variants.headline: Scripted where it counts. AI where it helps.
variants.subhead: Every post, reply and amplify runs exactly as written. Drafts, agents and assistants plug in through MCP, a REST API and a scriptable CLI.
variants.note: AI hybrid messaging, default and fallback (Yi, 2026-10-20 8:01 PM). The hybrid as a rule: deterministic actions, AI by choice, and the agent surfaces named.

variants.headline: You post. Your agent posts. Same rules.
variants.subhead: Drive LinkedIn, X, Reddit, Hacker News and more from the app, the CLI, MCP or your AI assistant. One queue, one set of limits.
variants.note: AI hybrid messaging. For the agent-heavy Alex persona: one queue and one set of limits, person or agent.

variants.headline: Your voice, automated. AI optional, never in charge.
variants.subhead: Blowhorn runs your schedule like clockwork, signed in as you. Write every word yourself, bring your own model, or let Blowhorn draft it.
variants.note: AI hybrid messaging. AI assists, the person decides; points at the content generation teaser.

variants.headline: One queue. Every profile. Human or AI.
variants.subhead: Publish and amplify from every profile you run, on every machine you own. Drive it by hand, by script or by AI agent.
variants.note: AI hybrid messaging. The fleet plus agents: any number of machines and profiles, three ways to drive.

variants.headline: Not a bot. You, at full volume.
variants.subhead: Blowhorn does the typing and clicking in your own Chrome, signed in as you, on machines you own. No Blowhorn server ever logs in as you.
variants.note: Default and fallback. Leads with the claim every competitor group lacks: real Chrome, really you.

variants.headline: The real you, everywhere at once.
variants.subhead: Not a cloud bot borrowing your password. Your own Chrome, on your own machines, doing exactly what you queued.
variants.note: Same claim, framed against the LinkedIn tools that ask for your password.

variants.headline: Your fleet. Your Chrome. Your voice.
variants.subhead: Install Blowhorn on every machine you own. They share one queue, act as you, and are coordinated so the same post isn't sent from two of them.
variants.note: The fleet of your own machines behind one coordinated queue.

variants.headline: Real voices make a sound wave.
variants.subhead: Schedule one message and have every profile you add amplify it at the moment you pick, each profile posting as itself.
variants.note: The sound wave, with real people instead of bots.

variants.headline: Own your voice. Keep your accounts.
variants.subhead: The social console that runs in your own Chrome: LinkedIn, X, Reddit, Hacker News, Bluesky, GitHub and Slack from one queue, posted as you. About a minute to set up.
variants.note: After bindplane.com: a category claim with concrete proof (the networks, the setup time) and an ownership close like its "Own your telemetry. Control your costs."
